summary: U.S. Gold Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce a change in the date of its annual meeting of stockholders to October 13, 2026, and to update deadlines for stockholder proposals and director nominations. The filing is a routine procedural notice under Rule 14a-5(f) related to meeting scheduling, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing contains no deal terms or financial transactions.
